input.title: Women's Cat – Oops. Anyway. Hoodie
input.descriptionHtml:
The Story

This funny cat hoodie says OOPS. ANYWAY. for the woman whose cat just knocked the coffee off the counter and walked away without a flicker of guilt.

A smug grey tabby rests one paw on a round wooden stool while a striped mug tips over mid-splash, coffee frozen in the air. OOPS. runs across the top in burnt orange and ANYWAY. across the bottom in mustard, both with a dark outline.

Pull it on for slow Saturday mornings, couch days with the cat and cold walks to the coffee shop. Original art, made for Graphic Tees Co. and printed to order.

Details & Fit

  • Classic unisex fit, pullover with a double-lined hood and matching drawcord
  • 50% pre-shrunk cotton, 50% polyester
  • Fabric weight: 8.0 oz/yd²
  • Air-jet spun yarn with a soft feel
  • Front pouch pocket, ribbed cuffs and waistband with spandex
  • Sizes S–3XL
  • Colors: Sand, Navy
  • Blank product sourced from Bangladesh, Nicaragua, Honduras or El Salvador

Questions

What colors does the Oops. Anyway. cat hoodie come in?
The Women's Cat Oops. Anyway. hoodie from Graphic Tees Co. comes in Sand and Navy. The burnt orange and mustard letters, the grey tabby and the coffee splash all read clearly on both, so every word stays easy to read from across the room.

Is it a good gift for a cat lover?
Yes. The Oops. Anyway. hoodie suits any cat owner who has watched something fall off a counter on purpose. It is an 8 oz 50/50 fleece that is warm for winter. Graphic Tees Co. prints it to order; order by about December 8 for Christmas delivery with free US shipping over $45.

How does the Oops. Anyway. hoodie fit?
The Graphic Tees Co. Oops. Anyway. hoodie is a classic unisex pullover cut in sizes S through 3XL. Order your usual size for a regular fit, or go up one size for a roomier, cozier fit over a long-sleeve layer on a cold morning.

How do I care for it?
Machine wash this Graphic Tees Co. hoodie cold, inside out, with similar colors, then tumble dry low. The 8 oz 50% cotton, 50% polyester fleece is pre-shrunk, and washing inside out keeps the orange and mustard lettering and the cat looking sharp wash after wash.

Where does the print sit?
The Oops. Anyway. print sits across the chest above the front pouch pocket, about ten inches wide, with OOPS. on top, the cat and the falling mug in the middle and ANYWAY. underneath. Graphic Tees Co. prints it to order on the front only.
